profile.name: 树莓派 GPIO 引脚
profile.description: 这是树莓派单板计算机上的通用输入输出引脚接口，可用于数字输入、数字输出和边沿检测。实验中常用来连接 LED、按键、继电器以及简单传感器，实现设备开关控制、状态采集和基础自动化联动。
profile.description_en: These are the general-purpose input/output pins on a Raspberry Pi single-board computer, used for digital input, digital output, and edge detection. In laboratory setups they are commonly used to connect LEDs, buttons, relays, and simple sensors for switch control, state sensing, and basic automation tasks.
